tooltip.relics.magnet_offhand: Collects nearby drops while held in the main hand or offhand
message.relics.reward_held: A relic reward needs administrator reconciliation after an interrupted save; it will not be issued twice.
tooltip.relics.map.pending: No confirmed destination yet. Copies share the same origin.
tooltip.relics.map.resolved: Points to the committed Colossus destination.
tooltip.relics.map.unavailable: Use to redeem three emeralds once for this origin.
tooltip.relics.map.compensated: No destination or further payout. The original compensation is paid or queued.
tooltip.relics.map.invalid: Unknown origin — no target or payout.
relics.settings.title: Discover relics
relics.settings.unique: Large Colossus: one per world. Distance is measured from world spawn; terrain can extend the search.
relics.settings.colossus.help: Minimum from the initial world spawn. Nearby positions are tried first; unsuitable terrain can require longer travel.
relics.settings.error.colossus: Colossus distance: 4,000-100,000 blocks and at least twice the relic distance.
relics.settings.cell.help: 1500?10000 blocks. Smaller values create more search opportunities, not guaranteed sites.
relics.settings.distance.help: 512?4000 blocks, no larger than search spacing. Minimum between accepted centers.
relics.settings.obelisks.help: Greater than twice the region radius; no larger than four times search spacing.
relics.settings.region.help: 500?12000 blocks. Controls the area using the near-Obelisk chances. Regions cannot touch.
relics.settings.chance.help: Percent of search opportunities. 0 disables this type here. Terrain can reject a site.
relics.settings.anchor.help: The Obelisk chance is shared by both regions. Change it on the first chances page.
relics.settings.footer: Saved with this world or as defaults, according to the scope above.
relics.settings.load_error: Settings could not be read. Save explicitly replaces them; Cancel keeps the file.
relics.settings.save_error: Could not save. Check write permission for the config folder.
relics.settings.error.distance: Relic distance: 512?4000 blocks, no larger than search spacing.
relics.settings.error.obelisks: Obelisk distance must exceed 2? radius, and be at most 4? search spacing.
relics.settings.error.anchor: Use the same Obelisk chance in both regions.
relics.settings.error.chances: Each chance: 0?100%. Total for each region must not exceed 100%.
relics.settings.error.number: Enter whole blocks and percentages with at most two decimal places.
relics.settings.biomes.help: Choose Standard, Matching landscapes or a custom biome list per relic. Biomes and terrain still limit valid sites.
relics.settings.biome.unassigned: No landscape mapping; custom selection remains available.
relics.settings.biome.missing: Selected biomes missing from this registry:
relics.settings.server_unavailable: This server or legacy world has not supplied saved relic settings. No values are assumed. Configure future-world defaults after leaving the world.
relics.load.title: Relic world cannot be loaded safely
relics.load.reason.environment: The loaded generator, biome, datapack or relic data do not match the saved distribution plan. The old checksum alone cannot identify which change caused this.
relics.load.reason.seed: The world seed does not match the saved relic plan.
relics.load.reason.border: The world border does not match the saved relic plan.
relics.load.reason.structures: Structure generation was disabled after the relic plan was created.
relics.load.reason.generator: The current world generator is not supported for this saved relic plan.
relics.load.reason.unfinished: Initial relic planning was interrupted. This world has no complete saved plan.
relics.load.reason.unknown: Compatibility could not be verified. The exact cause is unknown; see the game log for details.
relics.load.recovery: World loading was stopped before saving. Restore the original mods, datapacks and generator settings, then try again. For an incomplete or damaged plan, restore a complete backup. Do not delete the relic plan.
relics.settings.error.revision: Unsupported generation revision. Restore the supported settings.
relics.settings.experience.discovery: More finds on shorter trips. Recommended.
relics.settings.experience.custom: Your advanced settings are in use.
relics.settings.preview.caption: Illustration only. This is not a world preview.
relics.settings.overview.note: Choose before creating your world. Suitable terrain is still required.
relics.settings.overview.saved: This world keeps its saved settings, including unexplored areas.
